name: the-cliff-whisper

scripts.build:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:electron: npm run build && npx cap copy @capacitor-community/electron
scripts.start:electron: npm run build:electron && cd electron && npm run electron:start
scripts.install:android: npm run build && set "JAVA_HOME=C:/Program Files/java/jdk-21.0.7" && npx cap run android
scripts.build:apk: npm run build:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.build:bundle: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat :app:bundleRelease

description: The Cliff Whisper — Idle / Roguelike / Deck Builder
